answer: In PoA, bonded collateral escrows make each identity accountable, while correlated equivocation links ostensibly separate actors: when k coordinated identities equivocate, the penalty grows as O(k²), so a sybil swarm cannot divide the cost into harmless fragments. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation; an echo across identities can therefore turn a planted garden of credentials into a gale of forfeited stake.
